title: CFDE Virtual Workshop Recording Available
bodyHtml: On January 31, 2025, the CFDE Knowledge Center hosted its inaugural virtual workshop, entitled "Navigating the Common Fund Data Ecosystem’s (CFDE) Data & Resources to Empower Scientific Discoveries." Speakers included Noël Burtt, Julie Jurgens, Jason Flannick, and Oliver Ruebenacker (CFDE Knowledge Center); Avi Ma'ayan and Giacomo Marino (CFDE Data Resource Center); John Fonner (CFDE Cloud Workspace Implementation Center); Jennifer Burnette (CFDE Training Center); David Jimenez-Morales (MoTrPAC); and Tiffany Graziano (Terra). Attendees learned about CFDE, how to navigate the data, tools, and knowledge within it, and how CFDE can accelerate common and rare human disease research and basic biological discoveries. If you couldn't make it, check out the workshop recording on YouTube.
